fmt_num <- function(z) {
  if (is.nan(z)) "NaN"
  else if (is.na(z)) "NA"
  else if (is.infinite(z)) if (z > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf"
  else sprintf("%.17g", z)
}

show_bb <- function(val) {
  if (is.list(val) && !inherits(val, "bbox")) {
    crs <- attr(val, "crs")
    crs_s <- if (is.null(crs)) "NULL" else if (is.na(crs)) "NA" else as.character(crs$input)
    return(paste0("LIST/", crs_s))
  }
  nums <- vapply(as.numeric(val), fmt_num, "")
  crs <- attr(val, "crs")
  crs_s <- if (is.null(crs)) "NULL" else if (is.na(crs)) "NA" else as.character(crs$input)
  paste0(paste(nums, collapse = ","), "/", crs_s)
}

token <- function(expr) {
  expr <- substitute(expr)
  warned <- character()
  val <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      eval(expr, parent.frame()),
      warning = function(w) {
        warned <<- c(warned, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) structure(conditionMessage(e), class = "errtok")
  )
  body <- if (inherits(val, "errtok")) {
    paste0("ERR ", gsub("\n", "\\n", as.character(val), fixed = TRUE))
  } else {
    show_bb(val)
  }
  if (length(warned)) {
    wtxt <- vapply(warned, function(s) gsub("\n", "\\n", s, fixed = TRUE), "")
    body <- paste0(body, "|", paste(wtxt, collapse = "|"))
  }
  body
}

fmt_num <- function(z) {
  if (is.nan(z)) return("NaN")
  if (is.na(z)) return("NA")
  if (is.infinite(z)) return(if (z > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf")
  if (z == 0 && (1 / z) < 0) return("-0")
  sprintf("%.17g", z)
}

show_mat <- function(val) {
  cn <- colnames(val)
  cn_s <- if (is.null(cn)) "" else paste(cn, collapse = "|")
  nums <- if (length(val) == 0) "" else paste(vapply(as.numeric(val), fmt_num, ""), collapse = ",")
  paste0(typeof(val), "/", nrow(val), "x", ncol(val), "/", cn_s, "/", nums)
}

ser_val <- function(val) {
  if (inherits(val, "probe_err")) return(paste0("ERR", "\x1f", esc(as.character(val))))
  if (is.null(val)) return("NULL")
  if (inherits(val, "crs")) {
    if (is.na(val)) return("NACRS")
    inp <- val$input
    wkt <- val$wkt
    return(paste("CRS", if (is.na(inp)) "NA" else esc(inp), if (is.na(wkt)) "NA" else esc(wkt), sep = "\x1f"))
  }
  if (inherits(val, "crs_parameters")) return(ser_par(val))
  if (is.list(val) && length(val) == 0) return("LIST")
  if (is.character(val)) return(paste0("CHR", "\x1f", if (length(val) != 1 || is.na(val)) "NA" else esc(val)))
  if (is.integer(val)) return(paste0("INT", "\x1f", fld_int(val)))
  if (is.logical(val)) return(fld_log(val))
  if (is.numeric(val)) return(paste0("DBL", "\x1f", fld_num(val)))
  paste0("OTHER", "\x1f", esc(paste(capture.output(str(val)), collapse = " ")))
}

    withCallingHandlers(
      eval(expr, parent.frame()),
      warning = function(w) {
        warned <<- c(warned, sub("[\r\n]+$", "", conditionMessage(w)))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      },
      message = function(m) {
        messaged <<- c(messaged, sub("[\r\n]+$", "", conditionMessage(m)))
        invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) structure(conditionMessage(e), class = "probe_err")
  )
  body <- ser_val(val)
  if (length(warned))
    body <- paste(body, paste0("W:", paste(vapply(warned, esc, ""), collapse = "\x1e")), sep = "\x1f")
  if (length(messaged))
    body <- paste(body, paste0("M:", paste(vapply(messaged, esc, ""), collapse = "\x1e")), sep = "\x1f")
  paste(label, body, sep = "\x1f")
}
